title: Dungeon events
summary: Surprises that can happen inside a dungeon: rule rooms, vaults, rival awakened, locked exits and more.

blocks.text: When a dungeon is generated, there is a 30% chance of an event, and a 20% chance of a second one. A pity rule makes them more likely the longer you go without (+15% per dungeon, guaranteed after 5). Only events allowed at the rank of the dungeon can happen, and at most one major event per dungeon.
